result.catalog_rule: Anyone may propose an accompanying memory. Archive staff explain the relationship between accounts in public, and let borrowers choose which versions to experience rather than silently merging them.
result.intimacy_tension: Borrowers grow closer to each other
result.borrower_scene: At supper, one neighbor asks to make a meal neither of them remembers. The other hears a wish for a shared future, and also a possible rejection of the memory that brought them together.
result.joint_seed: After a public discussion of the flood accounts, two neighbors cook together. One wants to borrow the newly added memory together; the other asks for time. Explore how both requests can be acts of care, and what the archive can offer without deciding for them.
